lawyer: Aminul Huq, Advocate for the petitioner, Abdul Wadud Miah, Addl. Attorney General with A.Y. Salehuzzaman D.A.G and Ahsanullah Patwary ----- for the opposite parties.
parties:
Bangladesh Supreme Court Bar Association
Vs.
Khondker Abu Bakr and another
full_judgment: 2. In their application the defendant petitioners who are the Supreme Court Bar Association and some of its office bearers submitted that the plaintiffs opposite parties one of whom was the Minister of Law and the Attorney General of Bangladesh and the other was a Minister of Local Government and Rural Development of the Government of Bangladesh brought the Title Suit for a declaration that the resolution No.3 dated 14-11-83 drawn up by the defendants for convening the Special General Meeting of the Supreme Court Bar Association on 30-11-83 for striking off the names of the plaintiffs from the list of members of the said Bar Association is illegal, malafide, ultra vires, void and is of no legal effect and for a decree for permanent injunction restraining the defendants from giving effect to the resolution No. 3. After filing the plaint the opposite parties immediately made an application for temporary injunction to restrain the defendant petitioners from holding the meeting scheduled to be held on 30-11-83. The plaintiff opposite parties got the injunction petition moved by the top law officers of the Government and obtained forthwith an ad interim injunction. The plaintiff opposite parties deliberately acted against the resolution of the petitioner No.1 and intentionally violated the resolution though there was nothing illegal in the said resolution as also in the holding of the impugned meeting on 30-11-83 or on any other date. In the said suit the plaintiff opposite parties made their position felt by the Court by describing themselves as Ministers and Attorney General and the obtainment of the ad interim injunction has created reasonable apprehension in the minds of the petitioner that they would not get free and fair trial if the suit is disposed of by the learned Munsif. The Bangladesh Supreme Court Bar Association is a leading institution of the Advocates of the highest Court of the land and on the other hand the opposite parties are powerful and influential persons as Ministers and Attorney General and the present dispute in the suit involves point of general public interest. The mention of the plaintiff opposite parties as Ministers and Attorney General and the conducting of the suit on their behalf by the highest law officer of the Government are also causes of embarrassment to the learned Munsif. So the interest of justice requires that the suit should be withdrawn and tried by this Court.
